Container.Name: stream-scheduler
Container.Overview: Stream Scheduler schedules your weekly live streams on YouTube by itself, with the date of each stream already in the title, points your Wix or WordPress page at the coming stream, and tells you by email, Discord, Slack or Pushover when one needs you.[br][br]Open the WebUI to use the app. Required: a Keyring password, which encrypts the sign-ins kept in appdata (choose one and keep it), and a user name and password for the login page that guards the WebUI.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The app in a web browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, schedules, history and the encrypted sign-ins.

Config.Name: Keyring password
Config.Description: Encrypts the sign-ins kept in appdata. Choose one now and keep it: with another password the saved sign-ins cannot be opened.

Config.Name: Web login user name
Config.Description: The user name asked on the login page before the WebUI opens.

Config.Name: Web login password
Config.Description: The password asked on the login page before the WebUI opens.

Config.Name: Dark mode
Config.Description: 1 for a dark frame around the app in the WebUI (the app's own theme is in its Settings).

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: The user that owns the files in appdata (99 is nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: The group that owns the files in appdata (100 is users on Unraid).
